say:1:1033121001:1.text: The ones around here definitely aren't.
say:1:1033121001:1.source_cn: 我不知道你说的是哪里的咕布林，但肯定不是这里的。
say:1:1033121001:1.male: The ones around here definitely aren't.
say:1:1033121001:1.female: The ones around here definitely aren't.

say:2:1033121002:1.text: It's like those guys are crazy. They attack people on sight and don't know how to retreat, even if they're injured.
say:2:1033121002:1.source_cn: 那些家伙像是发了狂一样，看到人就攻击，受了伤也不知道后退。
say:2:1033121002:1.male: It's like those guys are crazy. They attack people on sight and don't know how to retreat, even if they're injured.
say:2:1033121002:1.female: It's like those guys are crazy. They attack people on sight and don't know how to retreat, even if they're injured.

say:3:1033121003:1.text: See that guy lying there, screaming and crying? He was unlucky enough to encounter gruglins—and look what happened to him.
say:3:1033121003:1.source_cn: 看到躺在旁边鬼哭狼嚎的家伙了吗？他很倒霉，遇到了咕布林...
say:3:1033121003:1.male: See that guy lying there, screaming and crying? He was unlucky enough to encounter gruglins—and look what happened to him.
say:3:1033121003:1.female: See that guy lying there, screaming and crying? He was unlucky enough to encounter gruglins—and look what happened to him.

say:4:1033121004:1.text: Fortunately, the wound's not serious. It looks a lot worse than it is.
say:4:1033121004:1.source_cn: 还好，伤势不重，只是伤口看起来可怕了点。
say:4:1033121004:1.male: Fortunately, the wound's not serious. It looks a lot worse than it is.
say:4:1033121004:1.female: Fortunately, the wound's not serious. It looks a lot worse than it is.

say:5:1033121005:1.text: But I hope this doesn't happen again...
say:5:1033121005:1.source_cn: 但愿别再发生这种事了……
say:5:1033121005:1.male: But I hope this doesn't happen again...
say:5:1033121005:1.female: But I hope this doesn't happen again...
